title: Rani Bagh Food Tour | Delhi ke Om Corner Chole Bhature, Viral Vada Pav Girl & More | Veggie Paaji
description:
Join Veggie Paaji on a mouth-watering Delhi food tour as we dive into the vibrant and bustling Rani Bagh Market in Pitampura! From crispy Chole Bhature to spicy Kurkure Momos and the famous CDG Vada Pav, we explore the iconic street food joints that make Rani Bagh a food lover's paradise. Get ready for a flavorful journey through one of North Delhi's most popular shopping and food hubs!
